create.name: Cheryl Richardson
create.bio:
Cheryl Richardson is an American writer and coach whose work, for more than twenty-five years, has turned on one idea: that looking after yourself well is a practice, and one that spills over into how you treat the people and the world around you. She served as the International Coach Federation's first president, led the lifestyle makeover strand of The Oprah Winfrey Show and later toured with Oprah Winfrey. Her books include Take Time for Your Life, Life Makeovers, The Art of Extreme Self-Care, The Unmistakable Touch of Grace and Waking Up in Winter, and You Can Create an Exceptional Life, written jointly with Louise Hay.

These days her attention is on growing older consciously, which she calls the wisdom years: her audio programme Self-Care for the Wisdom Years treats later life as a move from ego towards soul. She hosts free Zoom gatherings on this theme, sometimes with guests, and posts the recordings on her YouTube channel, where an earlier eight-part series teaches a simple daily meditation habit. She also writes a weekly blog of personal stories and reflections, sent to her online community, and lives quietly with her husband, Michael Gerrish.

books.title: Take Time for Your Life: A 7-Step Program for Creating the Life You Want
books.author: Cheryl Richardson
books.description: A seven-step programme for putting your own life and priorities first. It was a New York Times bestseller.

books.title: Life Makeovers: 52 Practical and Inspiring Ways to Improve Your Life One Week at a Time
books.author: Cheryl Richardson
books.description: Fifty-two practical changes, one for each week of the year. It was another of her New York Times bestsellers.

books.title: The Art of Extreme Self-Care: 12 Practical and Inspiring Ways to Love Yourself More
books.author: Cheryl Richardson
books.description: A revised edition of her year-long self-care programme: one habit to change each month, twelve in all. Every chapter ends with further reading and listening.

books.title: You Can Create an Exceptional Life
books.author: Louise Hay and Cheryl Richardson
books.description: A book written together by Louise Hay and Cheryl Richardson. It has recently been released as an audiobook as well.

books.title: Self-Care for the Wisdom Years: Practical Ways to Celebrate the Mystery and Wonder of Aging
books.author: Cheryl Richardson
books.description: An audio programme in six sessions on ageing with awareness, with teaching, journaling prompts and guided practices. It looks at later life as a chance to live from soul rather than ego.

free_resources.title: Exploring the Wisdom Years: Zoom Gatherings
free_resources.description: Free live Zoom conversations on growing older with awareness, some with guests, with an archive of past recordings and resources. The videos are also on her YouTube channel.
